scope: The 32 review areas are workstreams. Mutually exclusive A/B/C alternatives are selected deliberately, not represented as simultaneous implementations. Implemented components do not imply that every independent acceptance gate has passed.

choices.choice: Develop the native six-editor engine and add selective open source specialists; retain development-preview labeling and per-workflow support claims.
choices.remaining: No complete Office replacement, overall superiority or production-ready claim. Each independent gate remains separately tracked.

choices.choice: Retain the six native editors and a callable local LibreOffice conversion adapter with isolated profiles/source hashes/separate copies. qpdf 12.4.2 is packaged as its complete 293-file distribution with matching copied hashes and passes actual packaged IPC structural checks.
choices.remaining: LibreOffice runtime/version/conversion probes timed out on this host and it is excluded from the validated package, as is unvalidated veraPDF. No replacement editing foundation or universal format compatibility is certified.

choices.choice: Retain PDF.js/PDFium/pdf-lib, Tiptap Markdown and HTML source/preview. Add stronger isolated PDF parsing and Markdown draft recovery; preserve unchanged Markdown source bytes without enabling experimental round trips.
choices.remaining: Six-editor asset/export/reopen/failure coverage is incomplete. Dirty Markdown keeps the existing serializer unless the user separately enables the prior experimental preference; no Monaco migration was needed for a demonstrated failure.

choices.choice: Run bounded document inspection in a child process with hard file/archive/actual expanded-byte limits, deadline/cancellation/output failure and internal OOXML relationship target checks; the isolated audit path passed in the actual package.
choices.remaining: No complete OOXML schema certification or OS sandbox. JavaScript heap ceilings do not bound every native allocation. Deeper profiles remain bounded rather than silently accepting exhausted checks.

choices.choice: Parse PDF objects/page trees in an isolated bounded worker. qpdf 12.4.2 passes source GUI malformed-input handling and corrected actual-package audit/valid-PDF structural smoke; its complete distribution and hashes are staged.
choices.remaining: veraPDF runtime is not installed/validated. A parse or qpdf structural result is not visual, PDF/A, PDF/UA or human accessibility certification.

choices.choice: Capture first-save baselines after shared publication. Journal dirty named/unnamed Markdown text every 15 seconds and on blur; actual process crash/relaunch, exact-byte separate-copy recovery and discard passed.
choices.remaining: DOCX/XLSX/PPTX/PDF/HTML draft-state integration and crash acceptance remain. Markdown drafts do not bundle newly pasted assets. Clean-source retention is independently verified with the experimental preference still off.

choices.choice: Persist bounded user retention choices, payload/occupied/free-space status, pruning ceilings and minimum free space; expose the storage budget in Tools and privacy.
choices.remaining: Compressed content-addressed blobs and a transactional metadata redesign are deferred. Storage bounds and skipped/pruned history must stay visible.

choices.choice: Keep verified separate-file restore and bounded text preview; add authenticated draft and portable saved-history recovery with exclusive new destinations on NTFS/exFAT.
choices.remaining: No arbitrary original replacement or full graphical document diff. An exFAT crash during exclusive copy may leave a partial new destination; success requires complete hash verification and existing files remain protected.

choices.choice: Offer an OS-protected application key and AES-GCM for new snapshots/drafts, plus password-protected portable saved-history export and verified separate-copy restore.
choices.remaining: Existing plaintext/metadata are not migrated or encrypted. Key migration, drive-loss recovery and complete current-file/application/system backups require separate work; same-user software is outside the OS-keystore protection boundary.

choices.choice: Share completed-temp publication, conflict fingerprints, per-path serialization, rescue errors and history warnings across JavaScript and native Sheets save publication; remove the in-place truncate fallback.
choices.remaining: The final fingerprint check plus rename is not an OS compare-and-swap. All-editor OS-lock/disk-full/process-termination stress and larger-file semantics remain independent acceptance work.

choices.choice: Assemble a matching unsigned development-preview package with candidate-specific evidence. The root typecheck across all configured workspaces passed; selected rebuilt desktop 11/11 and corrected actual-package smoke 12/12 passed. Inventory covers 3,204 files and 1,097 packaged build outputs match their source-build bytes.
choices.remaining: These scoped checks do not establish CI execution, independent reproducibility, signed provenance, a full broad unit-suite rerun or release acceptance. Independent full editor/failure and clean-machine acceptance remain.

choices.choice: The final selected rebuilt desktop suite passed 11/11: calendar create/import, SQLite entry/query/reopen, qpdf, privacy/200% focus, Markdown retained source and crash recovery, command focus, inspection and saved-version restore. Corrected actual-package smoke passed 12/12, including all six editor loads only.
choices.remaining: Full create/open/edit/save/reopen and failure acceptance in each packaged format, clean-VM acceptance and broader interaction coverage remain. Historical failed/interrupted batches are retained; no full unit-suite rerun or release acceptance is claimed.

choices.choice: Test real-filesystem publication conflicts, first-save history, corrupt vault/backup/draft bytes, quota/exclusion paths, rescue retention, and native Sheets safe publication; verify restored bytes and separate destinations.
choices.remaining: Full failure injection through every editor, disposable-VM disk-full/OS-lock trials and crash stress remain. Helper/contract coverage is not all-format GUI acceptance.

choices.choice: Extend modal focus to selects/textareas, status/error controls and 200% zoom; actual privacy-dialog focus and repaired command-palette keyboard/focus restoration passed in the final selected desktop batch.
choices.remaining: Complete editor keyboard tasks, multi-display/DPI/high-contrast assisted passes, two screen readers and output-document accessibility remain.

choices.choice: Publish all 32 choices with per-scope evidence/remaining gates, updated CLI/skill documentation and a delivery record distinguishing source, reference, selected desktop and packaged-load smoke results.
choices.remaining: New tools remain English-language UI. Full localization, all content-specific support disclosures and any professional/Office-equivalence claim need additional acceptance.

choices.choice: Assemble a separate complete unsigned Windows development-preview directory, retain prior releases, and pass the corrected actual-package 12-check smoke selection.
choices.remaining: Inventory and packaged build-byte equality are verified. Six editor loads are not full editing/failure acceptance; signed NSIS/MSIX, updates/uninstall, independent clean-machine portability and profile migration remain unvalidated. The unsigned preview is not an accepted release.

choices.choice: Keep unsigned-preview labeling and candidate-specific hashes/provenance instead of implying a trusted publisher or clean-machine certificate.
choices.remaining: A signing certificate/HSM/cloud identity and independent clean-machine Windows acceptance are not configured; no signed installer result is claimed.

choices.choice: Capture Office/runtime/corpus environment and run scratch-only Excel reference calculations using a new owned instance with macros disabled: Excel 16.0 build 20527 matched 1,200 native cases and live dependency refresh.
choices.remaining: The wider Word/PowerPoint reference run was interrupted by COM/resource failures. Fully pinned activation/channel, fonts/display/printer, external baseline and clean-machine reproduction remain.

choices.choice: Validate 82 native no-op cases and 79 target edits across 50 existing DOCX and 32 PPTX (including 30 synthetic decks); implement page/dimension/non-antialias comparison and pass five Office raster smoke pairs.
choices.remaining: The full independent 50-DOCX/30-PPTX rendered comparison and zero critical human-reviewed layout/repair defects are not established. The broader COM oracle was interrupted; synthetic part preservation is narrower evidence.

choices.choice: Pass 1,200 fresh native-sidecar formulas across 12 categories against independent expected results and installed Excel 16.0 build 20527, using numeric tolerance, exact financial display and typed results; both live models recomputed a changed dependency.
choices.remaining: This is not every advertised function, volatile/external model, locale/date edge, full financial category or universal Excel parity. Expand the corpus before widening claims.

choices.choice: Pass 17 macro-preservation checks over ten inert synthetic XLSM packages and seven guards/regressions: retain VBA/project signatures/control bindings; refuse OPC document-signature invalidation and unsupported destructive edits; distinguish editable pure-note VML from protected controls.
choices.remaining: No VBA/XLM runtime, object-model execution or valid-certificate signature acceptance. Synthetic sentinel preservation does not replace ten real executable XLSM reference fixtures. DOCM/PPTM macro flows remain outside demonstrated support.

choices.choice: Strengthen existing pivot recompute/refresh with ten changed-source aggregation fixtures, known independent results and OOXML definition serialize/reopen checks.
choices.remaining: Full independent pivot-cache/Excel refresh corpus, Power Query, OLAP/Data Model and external connections are not established by these fixtures.

choices.choice: Fix effects/media to start at the exact scheduled clock boundary; ten deterministic timing fixtures and existing playback checks passed.
choices.remaining: Ten real imported timed/interactive decks, codec support, physical audio offset/drift, pause/seek and human playback acceptance remain separate from deterministic clock tests.

choices.choice: Implement SQLite-serialized cooperative checkout/renew/release, bearer leases, fingerprints and separate conflict publication; verify 100 deterministic two-session disconnect/expiry/conflict scenarios and one independent-process check.
choices.remaining: No authenticated service, CRDT real-time coauthoring or 100 real multi-user network/reconnect trials. Desktop saves do not automatically join the protocol; cooperating writers must share its registry.

choices.choice: Retain the isolated native Mail companion and launch permission. Add callable bounded read-only Graph mail delta and Gmail metadata/history adapters, mock-only tests and CLI sync requiring explicit --enable plus a consented environment token.
choices.remaining: OAuth application registration/consent/refresh, live inbox/attachment/send/sync interoperability and native-profile Graph migration remain. No real account was read or test message sent; an adapter does not certify EWS replacement.

choices.choice: Implement ICAL.js local create/import/export, embedded-zone DST recurrence/exceptions and vCard contacts. Actual rebuilt GUI calendar creation and recurring-calendar import of three events with unchanged source bytes passed. The Google Calendar sync adapter remains read-only, explicit --enable and mock-verified.
choices.remaining: Live provider consent/refresh, invitations/delegation, offline write queues, contact-provider sync and full timezone database support remain. Passing local calendar GUI tasks does not establish provider interoperability.

choices.choice: Implement SQLite typed tables/records, optimistic conflicts, saved form definitions, escaped reports/CSV and bounded isolated queries. Rebuilt desktop entry/query/reopen and corrected actual-package database-record/isolated-query smoke passed; source CLI workflows also passed.
choices.remaining: Access file/form/report/VBA compatibility, a full visual form/report designer, DuckDB analytics and broader database workflow acceptance are not implemented or claimed.

choices.choice: Provide semantic tables, named inputs/status/errors and high-contrast styling for new tools. Real privacy-modal focus at 200% zoom and command-palette keyboard restoration passed; the final selected 75-case privacy/workspace source check passed.
choices.remaining: Narrator plus NVDA/JAWS, every editor task, high-contrast assisted tasks and output-document accessibility need human evidence. No compliance certification is claimed.

choices.choice: Default to local mode with per-feature/exact-origin approval, Chromium/main-fetch gating, redirect rechecks/credential stripping, cloud-AI/Mail launch gates and explicit --enable provider reads. Policy persistence and blocking passed in rebuilt desktop and actual-package smoke; 75 selected privacy/workspace source tests passed.
choices.remaining: This is not a system firewall: raw sockets/native helpers/existing mail clients remain separate. Five blocked-network cycles in each editor with whole-process observation and all remote-feature data flows remain unverified.

choices.choice: Expose workspace process memory/CPU and raw timings. Source SQLite FTS5 store/search-worker/OOM/truncated-scan behavior is verified on Node 24 after index-fixture repairs; the actual Electron 43.8.3/Node 24.22.0 package also passes FTS5 smoke.
choices.remaining: Repeated cold/warm quality-equivalent workloads, p50/p95 all-process memory, the same-machine upstream regression gate and Office confidence intervals remain unmeasured; FTS correctness is not a speed-superiority claim.

choices.choice: Keep core local workflows useful without AI, block cloud AI until enabled, and allow explicitly configured loopback model services through the existing custom-provider UI; guard native AI command permission.
choices.remaining: Local model/runtime/weight selection, licensed downloads, managed routing and the 30-task x five-run blinded quality/latency evaluation remain. No local-model quality or entitlement equivalence is claimed.

choices.choice: Retain inherited notices/product identity. Package the unmodified ICAL.js 2.2.1 source tgz, complete archive-identical MPL license and component record; verify generated packaged notices match source and include ICAL plus Rust crate/license texts. Stage the complete hash-verified qpdf distribution and its notices.
choices.remaining: Source/license inclusion and inventory/hash checks are verified at their recorded scopes; they are not legal/trademark certification, signed provenance or an independent-implementation claim. Unvalidated LibreOffice/veraPDF runtimes remain excluded.

validationNote: Selected rebuilt desktop 11/11, corrected actual-package smoke 12/12 (six editor loads only), root typecheck across all configured workspaces and the selected 75-case privacy/workspace check passed. Package inventory and matching built-output bytes are verified. Historical broad-suite failures/interrupted runs remain preserved; no full broad unit-suite rerun, production readiness, complete Office parity, signing or release acceptance is claimed. Counts describe separate scopes, not a quality score.
